transcript.text: Hello sir mujhe ak relationship se related question tha

Chhoro, rehne do ji
Aise udaas mat ho ji. Main aapka dard samajhti hoon. Baat karo na mujhse.
Mera man nhi hai abhi kuch bolne ka
Main baad me baat krti hu apse
Ok ji bye 🙏
Ruko toh ek baar ji. Bada yog aane wala hai.

Thik h ok bye 🙏
